coverage_summary: Reviewed all 9 trajectories. Several opaque boundaries are appropriately retained, but structural bindings, conditional routes, and documented parameters require revision.

findings.detail: The trajectory receipt binds pretraining_visual_tokens to the EVA-CLIP encoder, although visual tokens are produced by that encoder. The encoder should receive pretraining_square_image.

evidence.quote: Specifically, we use the ViTg/14 vision transformer from EVA-CLIP [69] as the image encoder.
The extracted visual embeddings form the foundation for subsequent cross-modal representation learning.

findings.required_change: Bind pretraining_square_image to the image encoder input; treat pretraining_visual_tokens as its output.

findings.detail: The segmentation/cropping step accepts the broad pretraining_image node without a full-field condition, so supplied single-cell instances can also appear to pass through segmentation.

evidence.quote: For full-field microscopy images lacking provided cell boundary annotations, singlecell instances are obtained using an automated segmentation pipeline.
Among them, LIVECell and cpg0000 consist of full-field microscopy images, whereas the remaining datasets provide single-cell images.

findings.required_change: Condition the segmentation route on full-field images lacking boundaries and retain the direct supplied-single-cell route as a bypass.

findings.detail: The operation type asserts a frozen visual encoder while the paper also states that the full architecture, including the image encoder, is optimized end-to-end.

evidence.quote: Freezing the image encoder allows scMIR to leverage pretrained visual priors, reduce computational cost, and limit the number of trainable parameters
During pretraining, the full scMIR architecture, consisting of the image encoder, Q-Former, and the proposed image reconstruction module, is optimized end-to-end.
The image encoder follows the standard BLIP-2 configuration and remains unchanged throughout this work.

findings.required_change: Use a neutral visual-transformer boundary and record the trainability contradiction as unresolved rather than naming the operation frozen.

findings.detail: The masking step omits the documented fact that the masking ratio is fixed, even though its numeric value is unavailable.

evidence.quote: A subset of these visual tokens is then randomly masked with a fixed masking ratio, while the remaining tokens are retained as contextual inputs.

findings.required_change: Record masking_ratio as fixed with an unspecified value, while retaining the documented random subset selection.

findings.detail: The projected-memory invocation specifies a linear projection, but the paper only states that masked visual embeddings are projected into Q-Former hidden space.

evidence.quote: the masked visual embeddings are projected into the Q-Former hidden space and used as memory inputs to a lightweight Transformer decoder composed of two decoder layers.

findings.required_change: Remove the unsupported linear-method claim or mark the projection realization unspecified.

findings.detail: The decoder call binds both unmasked_visual_memory and projected_visual_memory as simultaneous inputs, although the paper gives them as conflicting memory descriptions.

evidence.quote: the masked tokens are reconstructed using cross-attention to the unmasked memory from the image encoder.
the masked visual embeddings are projected into the Q-Former hidden space and used as memory inputs to a lightweight Transformer decoder

findings.required_change: Represent the two memory descriptions as mutually exclusive alternatives or retain one unresolved decoder boundary without simultaneous memory-port bindings.

findings.detail: The DIBaS and CM4AI bypasses target classification_single_cell_images even though the paper states that these full-field datasets did not undergo single-cell segmentation.

evidence.quote: Fullfield images were processed using the same preprocessing pipeline as in pretraining to maintain consistency, except for DIBaS, which contains bacterial images, and CM4AI, which includes only a limited number of cells; neither dataset underwent single-cell segmentation.

findings.required_change: Use a prepared full-field exception node or otherwise preserve the unsegmented input form for DIBaS and CM4AI; do not label these outputs single-cell images.

findings.detail: The cell-to-image aggregation changes a cell-axis input into an image-axis output without any image-to-cell grouping context or identity route.

evidence.quote: Single-cell representations are extracted using the pretrained models and then aggregated by average pooling to obtain image-level features.

findings.required_change: Add an image-to-cell correspondence context with unspecified fields, or preserve the aggregation as an opaque boundary whose grouping is explicit.

findings.detail: The multichannel classification branch has no explicit conditional branch and its channel-image representation drops the sample/cell axis before producing the shared classification_image_feature output.

evidence.quote: For multi-channel microscopy images, features are extracted independently from each channel using the same procedure.
The resulting channel-specific feature vectors are then concatenated to form the final image representation

findings.required_change: Mark the channel-wise route as conditional on multichannel input, preserve the sample/image axis, and keep it separate from the ordinary single-image aggregation path.

findings.detail: The classifier invocation omits the documented hidden-layer width of 128.

evidence.quote: For all general pretrained methods, a unified classifier architecture is adopted, consisting of a 128-dimensional hidden layer followed by a classification layer.

findings.required_change: Record hidden_width=128 in the classifier invocation or its preserved source parameters.

findings.detail: Channel-wise feature averaging is applied to clustering_image_representations, whose declared shape has no channel axis or channel-grouping context.

evidence.quote: For multi-channel datasets with varying feature dimensionality, channel-wise features are first averaged to ensure a consistent feature length across datasets.

findings.required_change: Represent the input with an explicit channel axis or add documented channel correspondence/grouping context before the averaging boundary.

findings.detail: The clustering trajectory ends at KMeans assignments and omits the documented NMI, purity-score, and ARI evaluation branches.

evidence.quote: Clustering performance is quantitatively evaluated using NMI, purity score (PS), and ARI.

findings.required_change: Add opaque metric-evaluation branches for NMI, PS, and ARI, or explicitly mark those evaluations outside this trajectory's scope.

findings.detail: The perturbation image-to-image-level aggregation has no image/site grouping context despite changing from single-cell features to image-level features.

evidence.quote: Image-level features are obtained by average aggregation of single-cell features.

findings.required_change: Add an image-to-cell correspondence context, preserving its unspecified identifier fields and grouping rule.
